title: Orientation slate: handbook + screenshot kit for first-run console tour
creator: Ava Park
description:
Scope: Produce a compact "orientation slate" deliverable that combines a handbook PDF, a screenshot kit (device-agnostic), and annotated UX overlays for the Console first-run tour. This ticket covers visual assets and microcopy for: a persistent first-run checklist stripe, empty-state panels across Workspaces/Models/Routes, HUD microtips that appear contextually, and a set of high-fidelity screenshots for release notes and docs.

Deliverables: 1) handbook_console_orientation_v1.pdf (12 pages): tone, accessibility guidelines, copy variants. 2) screenshot_kit.zip: 11 PNG/JPEG screenshots (desktop@2x and mobile@2x), 3 layout variants (compact, roomy, screenshot-with-annotations). 3) figma frames: orientation-slate/handbook, orientation-slate/screenshots, orientation-slate/overlays. 4) sprite-sheet and SVG icons for empty states and checklist badges.

Constraints & non-goals: - This ticket is visual + copy only; no engineering implementation included. - Assets must follow existing design system tokens and the new compact spacing spec from design system v3. - Avoid creating new illustration language; use simplified glyphs and existing mascot assets.

Acceptance criteria: - Handbook PDF with approved microcopy and WCAG color contrast checks passed. - Screenshot kit contains at least 2 variants per primary screen and both 2x assets. - Annotated overlays specify component IDs and copy strings for engineers (component refs using existing tokens). - PM and Eng reviews completed and sign-off comment present in ticket.

Notes for engineers: include component refs in annotations (eg. #checklist-stripe-v2, #empty-state-illustration-small). If rollout requires toggles, supply two copy variants (short vs long) so engineers can wire feature-flagged copy.

Links to artifacts (work-in-progress):
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/console-orientation-slate
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/98765/Orientation+Slate+PRD
- Drive folder (exports & PDFs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED
- Reference GitHub PR for sample markup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1456

Open questions: 1) Should the checklist stripe include a dismiss / snooze affordance for 14 days? (PM prefers snooze) 2) Do we ship all empty-state art as vector SVGs to reduce size? (Engineering prefers SVGs but some marketing needs raster JPGs for thumbnails)
decisions: Use compact spacing token set (DS-v3-compact) for all first-run panels
Checklist stripe will remain pinned to top of routes list in desktop; collapsible on mobile
Primary CTA copy: 'Finish setup' (short) + secondary 'Remind me later' (snooze)
Deliver SVGs as canonical assets and rasterize thumbnails for marketing
